title: ALLNOBLANKROW as a CALCULATE modifier only removes the filter: orphan rows still count
query: EVALUATE CALCULATETABLE ( ROW ( "r", CALCULATE ( [Sales Amount], ALLNOBLANKROW ( 'Product'[Color] ) ) ), 'Product'[Color] = "Red" )

source.quote: It does not materialize the resulting table when called directly in a filter argument of CALCULATE or CALCULATETABLE
source.supports: as a direct filter argument ALLNOBLANKROW removes the filters and is not materialized as a table

source.quote: The behavior shown in this article applies to four functions
source.supports: SQLBI lists ALLNOBLANKROW among the functions that act as filter removers in CALCULATE

derivation: As a modifier ALLNOBLANKROW ( Product[Color] ) removes the filter Color = Red and applies no filter of its own. Nothing filters Sales: 100 + 30 + 50 + 20 = 200.
notes: SUM of a fixed decimal (currency) column is taken to be a fixed decimal, as in the seed cases. If ALLNOBLANKROW were instead applied as a table filter (the colors Red and Blue, without the blank row), the orphan Sales rows would be excluded and the result would be 100 + 30 = 130; both sources say it is not.
